overview.heading: Teaching, research, and professional learning
overview.description: Science teaching, an undergraduate biofuel study, and training in educational technology and responsible AI.
overview.biography:
My work as a science teacher starts with helping students ask clear questions and use evidence to answer them. I completed 360 hours of supervised teaching at Julio Ledesma National High School, where I planned and delivered science lessons.

I studied science education at Central Philippines State University and co-authored a thesis comparing briquettes made from sugarcane bagasse and corn stalks. My professional learning since then has included high school physics instruction, classroom feedback, environmental science, and responsible AI use in education and research.
overview.learning_description: Explore certificates in high school physics, explicit instruction, action research, environmental science, educational technology, and responsible AI.
